# Kuicksilver

> QUIC, HTTP/3, Kotlin Multiplatform: a QUIC and HTTP/3 library with a Ktor client and server engine, for Android, iOS, JVM, Native (Linux, macOS, Windows), on a statically linked, signature-checked OpenSSL 3.5 LTS.

Published on Maven Central under `io.kuicksilver` (Apache-2.0). Modules: kuicksilver-native (the `ksl` C shim and OpenSSL), kuicksilver-tls, kuicksilver-ktor-network, kuicksilver-quic, kuicksilver-http3, kuicksilver-http2, kuicksilver-ktor-client (`HttpClient(Kuicksilver)`), kuicksilver-ktor-server (`embeddedServer(Kuicksilver)`), and the kuicksilver-bom.

## Docs

- [Everything in one file](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/llms-full.txt): all the guides above concatenated (generated by tools/check/llms-full.sh)
- [README](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/README.md): what Kuicksilver is, quick start for the Ktor client, Ktor server and raw QUIC, modules, platforms
- [TLS guide](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/tls.md): TLS configuration, trust (platform verifier, RFC 9525 host name check, pins), TLS over sockets, key logging
- [QUIC guide](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/quic.md): QUIC connections, streams, datagrams, migration, admission and connection limits, the coroutine API
- [HTTP/3 guide](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/http3.md): HTTP/3 and QPACK over kuicksilver-quic
- [Ktor engines](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/ktor.md): the Ktor client and server engines, Alt-Svc discovery, fallback to HTTP/1.1
- [HTTP/2 on the client](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/ktor.md#http2-on-the-client): HTTP/2 over TCP for the Ktor client (ALPN `h2`, settings, HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED fallback)
- [HTTP/2 on the server](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/ktor.md#http2-on-the-server): serving HTTP/2 next to HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/3 on one TLS connector, flood limits
- [Deploying the HTTP/3 server](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/deployment.md): UDP and TCP on one port, Alt-Svc, firewalls, Docker, Kubernetes, load balancers and proxies, UDP buffers, GSO, checking a deployment
- [iOS guide](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/ios.md): using Kuicksilver from iOS and Swift
- [App Store](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/app-store.md): publishing an app that embeds Kuicksilver on the App Store
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/configuration.md): every option with its type, default, range, where it is set and since which release; HTTP/2 settings included
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md): symptoms by exact error text or code (handshake timeout, certificate errors, ALPN mismatch, CONNECTION_REFUSED and connection limits, 0-RTT, HTTP/3 fallback reasons, HTTP/2 failures) with cause and action

## Policies

- [API stability](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/stability.md): stable and experimental API, ABI checks, supported platforms, Ktor and OpenSSL policies
- [Development process](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/process.md): how every change is checked before a release: failing-first tests, review against the RFC text, the local gate on every target, hosted CI, soak, fuzzing, signed releases with SBOM and provenance
- [Verifying a release](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/verifying.md): signatures, Gradle dependency verification, SBOM and provenance, reproducible native libraries

- [Security policy](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reporting vulnerabilities, OpenSSL update commitments
